name: codex-profile-agents-disabled
goal: Enforce disabled nested agents in native Codex task profiles.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The official Codex client exposed collaboration with features.multi_agent=false. With agents.enabled=false and both multi-agent flags disabled its reported tool inventory excluded collaboration.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing prepare method cases asserted features.multi_agent=false but did not assert the client agent enablement or v2 override. Strengthen those cases without adding titles.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At b853f8a69f both existing prepare cases failed because their authored agent-disable expectations were false; the unchanged failing run is recorded.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Commit 1f1e95bab5 explicitly disables agents.enabled and features.multi_agent_v2 alongside the existing multi-agent flag.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged four-case matrix passed at 1f1e95bab5 using the recorded red command and the same sanitized environment profile.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
